notes: Two continuation bets on the dollar-strength and tech-selloff trends already confirmed in the tape; everything else (gold, semis, oil) looks too far into the crash stage to chase fresh.

rule_cited: The trend is your friend except at the end when it bends; stage-2 acceleration
teach: A trend with months of follow-through is safer to join than one that just started yesterday.
why: The dollar has climbed for three months while gold and copper keep falling; I expect that trend to keep running.

rule_cited: Find the flawed prevailing premise; reflexivity stage 3 reinforcement demands a tighter stop
teach: When a loud story cracks hard and fast, don't assume one bad month is just a dip.
why: Big tech names like Nvidia fell almost a third in a month; I think this keeps breaking down, not bouncing.
